messages:
Layla (Partnerships): Hey team — running final logistics for the co‑hosted hands-on lab with PartnerIO at CloudCon next week. Need quick confirmations: speaker list, what demos MUST be physical HW vs cloud fallback, swag counts, and a final run‑of‑show by EOD tomorrow.
Sam Ops: I can take point on the hardware shipping + customs. What SKU/weight we expect? ETA to booth?
Beth (PartnerIO): Shipping manifest incoming from our side by tomorrow noon. Primary demo uses our edge box (2U, ~22kg) + 1 accessories box. We can also run a containerized cloud demo if the box is delayed.
Tom Infra: For the container fallback we need the exact image tag and a note on GPU needs. If cloud, we should pre-provision 1xA10 per demo station to match latency experience.
Andre (Solutions): Speaker list: me (Andre), Priya (PartnerIO ENG), and Layla for a 10min intro. Andre will demo multi‑model routing and fallback. Priya will cover on‑device inference.
Maria Mktg: Swag ask: 300 stickers, 150 t‑shirts (L/XL mix), and 100 pocket guides. PartnerIO will bring 100 co‑branded postcards. Shipping address for swag drop?
Layla (Partnerships): Shipping address (booth storage): CloudCon Expo — Booth 213, Attn: Redwood/PartnerIO Ops, 400 Expo Ave, San Jose, CA 95112. Please mark "DO NOT DELAY — LAB KIT" on labels.
Sam Ops: Noted. Logistics Bot: created a pickup order with carrier options; customs paperwork template attached.
Logistics Bot: Carrier options: FedEx Priority (2‑3 business days), DHL Express (1‑2 business days). Required docs: Commercial Invoice (include model serials), NAFTA/HTS codes if needed, and an export classification statement. Link: https://files.company/swag-shipping-template.pdf
Tom Infra: For the cloud fallback, use image tag partnerio/edge-lab:v3.2. Start command for fallback station:
```
docker run --gpus all -p 8080:8080 partnerio/edge-lab:v3.2 --serve-mode=lab
``` 
Ensure ports 8080/9090 open on booth network.
Andre (Solutions): Run‑of‑show draft:
```
13:00 — 10m Layla intro + sponsor shoutout
13:10 — 20m Andre demo: multi‑model routing + latency breakdown
13:30 — 15m Priya (PartnerIO) on hardware setup + hands‑on exercise
13:45 — 20m Guided lab (attendees choose HW or cloud station)
14:05 — 10m Q&A + call to action (signup link)
```
Can someone map hands‑on station count?
Beth (PartnerIO): We can support 8 HW stations (one box per 2 stations via splitter). PartnerIO will bring 10 spare power cords and a network switch.
Maria Mktg: Registration: we need a shared landing page by Friday. I have assets (logo SVG, speaker bios). Can Andre and Priya send 1‑paragraph bios + headshots by EOD tomorrow?
Andre (Solutions): Sending bios + headshot to Maria in 30m.
Layla (Partnerships): Two open items: 1) confirm customs paperwork completed by Wed; 2) final A/V tech list for venue by Thursday. If hardware delayed, we will auto‑switch to cloud fallback and add a slide noting reproducibility. Everyone ok? :+1:
Sam Ops: I'll upload commercial invoice and tracking once booked.
Beth (PartnerIO): We'll confirm pickup slot today and share airway bill.
Maria Mktg: I'll scaffold the landing page with placeholders and connect the registration widget. Need the speaker bios to finalize.
Layla (Partnerships): Perfect. If anything blocks customs or shipping, @Sam Ops ping me ASAP. Thanks all — this thread will be the single source of truth for lab ops. :sparkles:
